prepSteps.title: Run Entro's Azure onboarding script
prepSteps.instruction: On a workstation with PowerShell 7 and Az modules, run Entro's automated onboarding script as a Global Administrator so it creates the app, secret, and required Graph / Azure permissions.
prepSteps.evidence: The script reports success and Entra shows the Entro app registration

prepSteps.title: Record tenant, client ID, and secret
prepSteps.instruction: Copy Tenant ID, Application (client) ID, and the generated secret Value into the operator vault. Do not paste the secret into chat.
prepSteps.evidence: Tenant ID and Client ID are visible on the app Overview; secret Value is stored outside the session

typedActions.preview: Script has no vendor dry-run; checksum the Skill-held file, review path/size/checksum, then Approve. Entro docs describe a local run only.
typedActions.target: Entra tenant and selected Azure subscriptions / management groups
typedActions.expectedChange: Entro app registration EntroSecurityApp exists with Entro permission-audit Graph and Defender grants on the Identity object
typedActions.verification: sha256 of integrations/microsoft-ecosystem/Entro-Azure-Onboarding.ps1 matches script.checksum; script prints Azure Client ID, Tenant ID, and Client Secret; az ad app list --display-name EntroSecurityApp --query [].appId
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Script does not declare automatic rollback; residual Entra app, custom role, and Log Analytics resources must be deleted manually if the operator stops

script.version: Entro-Azure-Onboarding.ps1 Local onboarding fork (origin upload 7pmnww8A099dTyQLXKT0; Entro permission-audit set; Az.Resources 9 PSRoleDefinition Actions/NotActions; TeamsAppInstallation.ReadWriteSelfForUser.All; ordered permission-group lookup; lazy WindowsDefenderATP service-principal provisioning)

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Record tenant, client ID, and secret
typedActions.preview: Platform has no dry-run for this change; disclosed as no-preview.

typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Irreversible for a revealed secret Value; rotate by creating a new secret and deleting the old one in Entra

prepSteps.title: Register the Entro app in Entra
prepSteps.instruction: In entra.microsoft.com, register a single-tenant app for Entro, create a client secret, and add the Graph / Azure application permissions from Entro's permissions reference, then grant admin consent.
prepSteps.evidence: App Overview shows Tenant ID and Client ID; API permissions show admin consent

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Register the Entro app in Entra
typedActions.preview: az ad app create has no dry-run; disclose display name and permissions then Approve
typedActions.mutation: az ad app create --display-name <display_name> --sign-in-audience AzureADMyOrg ; then add Graph/Azure application permissions from Entro's permissions reference and az ad app permission admin-consent
typedActions.expectedChange: Single-tenant app exists with admin-consented application permissions
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Delete the app registration if the operator stops (az ad app delete --id <appId>); admin consent is not fully reversed by delete alone for issued tokens

prepSteps.title: Enable continuous onboarding of subscriptions
prepSteps.instruction: Deploy Entro's Azure Function App against the Tenant Root management group so new subscriptions and Key Vaults onboard without repeating the wizard.
prepSteps.evidence: The Function App is running and new subscriptions appear in Entro without a second wizard run

operatorOnly.reason: Function App and management-group wiring is documented as Azure Portal / ARM, not a preferred CLI plan
operatorOnly.evidence: The setup leverages Microsoft Azure Functions to periodically invoke Entro's onboarding API

prepSteps.title: Add Copilot Studio Graph permissions
prepSteps.instruction: On the same Entra app used for Microsoft Ecosystem, add the Copilot Studio / Power Platform Graph application permissions from Entro's Copilot Studio permissions list, then grant admin consent for the tenant.
prepSteps.evidence: API permissions page shows the Copilot Studio scopes with admin consent granted

prepSteps.title: Provision the app into Dataverse environments
prepSteps.instruction: Using the Power Platform CLI as a Global Administrator, add the Entro Entra app as an application user in each Power Platform environment that hosts Copilot Studio agents.
prepSteps.evidence: Each target environment lists the Entro app under Application users

typedActions.preview: Platform has no dry-run for this change; disclosed as no-preview.
typedActions.mutation: az ad app permission add --id <appId> with Copilot Studio / Power Platform application permission IDs from Entro's Copilot Studio permissions list, then az ad app permission admin-consent --id <appId>
typedActions.target: Same Entra app as Microsoft Ecosystem
typedActions.expectedChange: API permissions include Copilot Studio scopes with admin consent
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Remove the added Graph permissions (az ad app permission delete) then re-consent; tokens already issued remain until expiry

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Provision the app into Dataverse environments
typedActions.preview: pac admin list shows target environments; assign-user has no dry-run beyond listing application users first
typedActions.target: Power Platform / Dataverse environments that host Copilot Studio agents
typedActions.expectedChange: Each locked environment lists the Entro app as an application user
typedActions.verification: pac admin list-application-users --environment <environment_id> (or Power Platform admin → Application users)
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Remove the application user from Dataverse environments; no automatic rollback command is cataloged

operatorInputs.prompt: Power Platform environments that host Copilot Studio agents
operatorInputs.purpose: Dataverse environments the Entro app is added to as an application user
operatorInputs.validation: Environment ID (GUID) or environment URL as pac admin list reports it; separate several environments with commas
